title: Textile Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP) - Stage-by-Stage Process Rules

stages.objective: Remove physical debris, equalize flow rate, balance temperature, and homogenize COD/pH variations from batch dyeing processes.

operating_rules.rule: Maintain air agitation at 1.5 - 2.0 m³/m²/hr to prevent sludge settling and septic odor formation.
Effluent retention time in Equalization Tank must be maintained between 12 to 24 hours to handle batch shock loads.
Effluent temperature entering biological stage must not exceed 40°C. Operate cooling tower if raw feed > 45°C.
Clean rotary fine drum screens continuously to prevent lint build-up and pump cavitation.

stages.objective: Destabilize colloidal unfixed dyes, suspended fibers, and insolubles; remove 70-80% TSS and 40-60% COD.

operating_rules.rule: Flash mixing speed (G-value > 300 s⁻¹) must be maintained for 1 to 3 minutes for rapid coagulant dispersion.
Maintain optimum pH 6.5 - 7.5 when using Alum or PAC; maintain pH 8.5 - 10.0 when using Ferrous Sulfate.
Flocculation mixing speed must be slow (G-value 20-70 s⁻¹, 15-40 rpm) for 15 to 30 minutes to form large settleable flocs without shearing.
Primary Clarifier surface overflow rate (SOR) must be maintained at 15 - 25 m³/m²/day.

stages.stage_name: Secondary Biological Aeration (Activated Sludge / MBBR / MBR)
stages.objective: Aerobic bio-degradation of soluble organic pollutants (BOD and COD) using active biomass/microorganisms.

operating_rules.rule: Maintain Dissolved Oxygen (DO) strictly between 2.0 to 3.0 mg/L in aeration basin. DO < 1.5 causes sludge bulking; DO > 4.0 wastes energy.
Maintain MLSS between 3,000 - 4,500 mg/L for ASP, 5,000 - 8,000 mg/L for MBBR, and 8,000 - 12,000 mg/L for MBR.
Maintain nutrient ratio BOD : N : P at 100 : 5 : 1. Dose Urea and Di-Ammonium Phosphate (DAP) if influent is nutrient-deficient.
Maintain Sludge Volume Index (SVI) between 80 - 120 mL/g. SVI > 150 indicates filamentous bio-sludge bulking.
Maintain RAS (Return Activated Sludge) flow rate at 50% to 100% of incoming effluent flow rate.

stages.objective: Refractory hard-COD removal, color destruction, and polishing filtration before membrane system.

operating_rules.rule: For Fenton Oxidation, maintain exact reaction pH of 3.0 - 3.5 using H2SO4; dose FeSO4 and H2O2 in molar ratio 1:3 to 1:5.
Neutralize Fenton effluent with Caustic/Lime to pH 7.5 - 8.5 to precipitate ferric hydroxide sludge before filtration.
Backwash Dual Media Filter (DMF) and Activated Carbon Filter (ACF) daily or when differential pressure exceeds 0.8 bar.
Ensure Silt Density Index (SDI15) of ACF permeate is strictly < 3.0 prior to feeding Ultrafiltration (UF) and Reverse Osmosis (RO).

stages.stage_name: Ultrafiltration (UF), Reverse Osmosis (RO) & Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD)
stages.objective: Recover high-purity permeate water (> 90-95%) for textile process reuse and concentrate salt brine for evaporation/crystallization.

operating_rules.rule: Dose Antiscalant (3-5 ppm) and Sodium Metabisulfite (SMBS 2-5 ppm) prior to RO feed to prevent silica/calcium scaling and chlorine membrane damage.
Maintain RO Feed Operating Pressure between 15-25 bar (Stage 1) and up to 60-80 bar for High-Pressure RO Reject recovery.
Clean-In-Place (CIP) for RO membranes must be initiated when permeate flow drops by 10% or differential pressure increases by 15%.
Feed high TDS RO Reject brine (TDS 70,000 - 100,000 mg/L) to Multiple Effect Evaporator (MEE) to crystallize dry salt and recover 100% water.
